svg.title: Risk-coverage curve of the Lab 1 classifier (measured)
svg.desc: A plot of selective risk, the error rate among the cases acted on, from 0 to 0.14, against coverage, the share of cases acted on, from 0 to 1. The measured curve of the Lab 1 classifier with C = 10 is 0 up to a coverage of about 0.13, then rises, slowly at first and faster near full coverage, to the plain error rate 0.116 at coverage 1. A dotted horizontal line at 0.116 is random abstention. A dashed oracle curve is 0 up to coverage 0.884 and then rises almost linearly to 0.116 at coverage 1. The model's curve lies between the two. A dot marks Chow's threshold lambda* = 0.9, for l_wrong = 10 and l_defer = 1: coverage 0.578, risk 0.022.
svg.text: oracle (dashed): defers the 11.6% it gets wrong first
